ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate <Route path="applications"> under modules/:code — the generic ModulePartnerApplications route (line 106) shadowed the new AdminFoodApplications route (line 139), so /admin/modules/food/applications rendered the legacy MART Partner Applications table instead of the new FOOD applications queue. FIXED by introducing ApplicationsSwitch dispatcher on code === 'food'.

action_items: Verify the ApplicationsSwitch dispatch pattern (added in /app/frontend/src/apps/admin/AdminApp.jsx) matches the existing CatalogSwitch/AttributesSwitch/ApprovalsSwitch/ProductsSwitch pattern — it uses useOutletContext().code === 'food' to render AdminFoodApplications, otherwise ModulePartnerApplications. Please review and confirm no other module needs a dedicated applications component (e.g., SHOP).
critical_code_review_comments: Route collision (fixed): Two children of <Route path="modules/:code"> both used path="applications" — React Router v6 picks the first, so the new FOOD queue was unreachable at its own URL. Any future dedicated-per-module page should either be nested under a code-specific segment or use a Switch dispatcher pattern.

The activation_url is only ever returned on the approve-action response (dev only) and is NOT persisted in the application detail. That's fine for QA but if any future flow needs to re-fetch it (e.g., 'Resend activation email' button) the backend would need to expose a dedicated re-generate endpoint.

rca of the issue: AdminApp.jsx had two <Route path="applications"> children under the same parent <Route path="modules/:code">. React Router picked the first (ModulePartnerApplications), so /admin/modules/food/applications never mounted AdminFoodApplications — the entire admin FOOD-onboarding queue was unreachable from the UI (backend was fine). Reproduction: log in as super-admin, go to /admin/modules/food/applications → observe legacy MART 'Partner Applications' table instead of the new 'Demandes de restaurants' queue. Fix: replaced both routes with a single ApplicationsSwitch component that dispatches on useOutletContext().code === 'food' to AdminFoodApplications, otherwise falls back to ModulePartnerApplications. Verified end-to-end: search, drawer, per-doc review, correction, approval, activation URL all reachable.
